ruling: Tim 2026-10-25 19:25 ET: Each application avenue is its own opportunity and its own row. Do not build one opportunity with child channels. Notes on both rows record the relationship (other primary id, same employer role, different application door). A second door is not a hard duplicate and must not stall intake. The identical employer requisition is still one application. Declined, rejected, and applied history is never overwritten. Policy wording only. No engineering until Tim names a builder.
